summary.text: Laura Parra is the Democratic candidate for the New Mexico House of Representatives, District 32, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Jenifer Jones (R) after advancing from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a social worker, therapist and community organizer who serves as Mayor Pro Tem and a Deming city councilor.

paragraphs.text: Parra earned a high school diploma from Deming High School, and her career experience includes working as a public servant.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she is the oldest daughter of immigrant parents and the founder of Voices for Change, a youth-led civic engagement and community advocacy organization, and that she is a Deming City Councilor for District 2.
Parra said her campaign focuses on healthcare access, education, economic opportunity and ensuring rural communities are not left behind.

She said she is committed to expanding behavioral healthcare access, supporting public education, investing in infrastructure and creating economic opportunities for working families, farmworkers and young people.
